answer: Copper-mooring bond blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer stakes 70 credits and winds a spiral copper chain round a post, serial in the ledger, one post one chain. Each epoch it pays a 45-credit nectar toll; the auditor counts chains per post. Rented-mooring rings fail: a second chain or unpaid toll burns the bond. A 1,000-fake farm needs 1,000 posts: 1,000 x 45 = 45,000 toll, 5,000 over a 40,000 pool, plus 70,000 locked. Honest agents pay only 45.
